Amoeba v1.0 As-Built

Amoeba drafts a team of AI helpers for each task and runs it step by step. From D117 it adapts within a single task, when a step gets stuck; nothing carries over between tasks. The AI proposes; plain code decides. This page is built from the code at the commit below, not from the plan.

  • Boxes 1–3 · one taskRead the task, plan a team, run it step by step. Every AI call is logged.
  • Box 4 · adapt within the taskD117 removed the offline learning loop. Inside one task, plain code watches each step for stuck signals, tries code fixes cheapest first, then asks the fix proposer for one checked edit; the task stops with a report when nothing recovers the step.
  • Use the pageClick a box to open it. ⓘ shows the code, prompt and tests; ✎ asks a question or requests a change.

History

Box 3 gaps: the wires that were missing (7 of 7 closed)

Information a run recorded that the code judging steps and assembling the answer did not read. Found in observer rounds 1–3 (docs/eval/round3/report.md): giving the team more capabilities raised what it could do, but not whether it used them or reported gaps, because these wires were missing. 7 of 7 closed (solid green on the Box 3 view; open gaps are dashed red): D61, the step contract, lists before each step what every helper must account for and checks the evidence after it.

GapWireExists atWas not read atSeen inClosed by
G1Capability record → step status
Which requests each helper asked for and did not get (capability_requests.json, missing_tools) never reaches the status check: a step is 'done' unless the helper itself wrote BLOCKED.		amoeba/pool/stock.py:196, scripts/run_task.py:248amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1130r1-route, all rounds: distances from memory in a 'done' step with no routing tool; r1-code-run, round 2b: 'done' without the code being runD61: before the step plain code lists each helper's unfilled requests (step contract, shown on its prompt); after it, one that is neither BLOCKED nor NOT NEEDED earns one refine turn, then makes the step partial ("not declared by the helper").
amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:626, amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:651, amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1117
G2Tool-call trace → step status
Whether the helper called the tool or skill attached for its request is logged (execute_tool, local_call) but never read when the step is judged.		amoeba/interp/runtime.py:351, amoeba/localtools/toolbox.py:459amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1130r1-deck, round 2: pool slide tool attached, 0 calls, step 'done'; r1-deck, round 3: pptx skill + local tools attached, 0 calls, step 'done'D61: every tool call of the step is recorded (who, tool, ok); an attached item with no successful call and no BLOCKED / NOT NEEDED line earns one refine turn, then makes the step partial ("attached unused").
amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1720, amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:303, amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:651
G3Capability record → Limitations
Limitations are built only from the BLOCKED marks helpers wrote; the run's unfilled requests are never compared with the answer.		amoeba/pool/stock.py:196amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1574r1-fx-email, all 4 rounds: the missing email sender is never named; r1-route: the missing routing tool is never named; r1-weather 2b: missing current conditions not namedD61: Limitations also get every undeclared missing capability and every attached item left unused (NOT USED lines), matched by canonical name.
amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1569, amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1560
G4Checked step's sources → verifier
A verify step sees only its declared inputs, not the tool results behind the step it checks.		amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1068amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:969r1-weather, round 2: a real, cited forecast fetched in step 1; the verifier (depends on step 2 only) wrote BLOCKED 'Step 1 output' and the answer said 'failed verification'D61: a verify step's inputs carry, per checked step, its sources, tool calls (ok or failed), figure counts, files made and what it lacked or left unused.

G5Produced work → answer check
Figures and files produced upstream (figure ledger, files_created) are recorded but never checked against the final answer; after a FAIL the summariser writes a status memo instead.		amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1515, amoeba/localtools/toolbox.py:563amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1530r1-xlsx, rounds 1–2b: lane totals, 79,800 and 1,855.81 computed in step 1, absent from every answerD61: the answer step is told which files each step made; files and source-cited figures the answer leaves out earn one refine turn, and files still unnamed are listed by plain code.

On a FAIL verdict every checked producer is re-run, whatever the cause; a missing capability does not change between attempts.		amoeba/pool/stock.py:196amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:1680rework in 6 of 10 runs in round 2 and again in 2b; none changed a blocked step (r1-full-chain: 3 reworks, 2 stale)D61: each step records its causes; a producer whose only cause is a missing capability is not reworked (rework_skipped).

Glossary

helper
One AI worker in a team, with its own name, instructions and allowed tools.
team shape (topology)
How helpers are connected; fixed when a run starts, never chosen by an AI.
step by step (flat)
The plan's steps run in order; each step's helpers take turns until they give a final answer.
one writer with reviewers (boss + reviewers)
One helper writes the answer, the others review it, the writer revises on objections.
draft
The planner's proposed helpers and step plan for one round.
round
One planner reply plus one reply from each checker.
turn
One reply from each helper of a step.
consensus
Both checkers wrote 'No Suggestions' in the same round.
section
A '## Heading' part of an AI reply that plain code cuts out and reads.
guard
A plain-code check that rejects, corrects or caps what an AI produced (shield icon).
envelope
The fixed rules a team must satisfy: allowed tools per role and the team-size limit.
trace
The log file with one line per AI call, tool call, helper turn and run.
token
The unit AI services count text in; recorded per call, never enforced in Phase 1.
sample run
One practice job run with the offline stand-in AI when this page was built.
stand-in AI
A scripted fake AI used offline; it is not a real model.
deviation
A deliberate difference from the original AutoAgents / AgentVerse code, marked in the source.
